title: Letter to the Editor regarding, "Accuracy of 3D scan data of extraorally digitized removable complete dentures with or without metal bases obtained with intraoral scanners"
html: We read with great interest the comprehensive in vitro study by Jeon et al1 that evaluated the trueness and precision of 3 intraoral scanners (IOSs) in extraorally digitizing removable complete dentures with different denture base materials was of keen interest. The systematic comparison of the TRIOS 5, i900, and Primescan can aid clinical considerations for the selection of these scanning systems. We aim to present ideas on the practical implications of the findings in question.
